purpose: Master reference inventory: each Profile-B biological structure -> lawful reference source(s) (from data/profile-b-license-registry.json) + the biological APPEARANCE an illustrator should reproduce. No artwork copied; appearance is lighting-independent and stain-color-independent. Every structure has >=1 verified-policy source; per-file verification still required.
